position.description: The rank the card takes in the column it ends in, counting from 0 at the top. A rank past the end puts the card last. Pass at most one of `position`, `beforeCard` and `afterCard`.

beforeCard.description: The number or the id of a card of the column the card ends in. The card lands just above it. A number may be sent as a JSON integer too.

afterCard.description: The number or the id of a card of the column the card ends in. The card lands just below it. A number may be sent as a JSON integer too.

status.description: The slug of a column on this board. A change appends the card to the end of the column, unless the call also names a place.

pullRequestUrls.description: The full set. Leave it out to keep the links, and send an empty list to remove them all.

relatedCards.description: The full set. It replaces every link that touches the card, including links written from the other card.

parentCardId.description: The id of the new parent. Leave it out to keep the parent. An empty string clears it.

clearParent.description: True removes the card from its parent. Do not pass it with `parentCardId`.

laneEnabled.description: Whether the board draws a lane for the card.

childDesign.description: As in card creation. Pass no `status` with `own`.

requiresHumanReview.description: A bridge worker can only turn it on.

values.description: Maps a declared key to its value, such as `{"tech-design-interactive": true}`. A key you leave out keeps its value. One bad entry refuses the whole call.

rank.description: The rank in the column, counting from 0 at the top.

column.description: The slug of an open column of the board.

cards.description: The cards of the block from top to bottom. Name each card by its number or its id. A number may be sent as a JSON integer too.

at.description: Where the block goes: `top` or `bottom` of the column. Pass exactly one of `at`, `beforeCard` and `afterCard`.

beforeCard.description: The number or the id of a card of the column that is not in the list. The block lands just above it.

afterCard.description: The number or the id of a card of the column that is not in the list. The block lands just below it.

above.description: The card just above the block, or null when the block is first.

below.description: The card just below the block, or null when the block is last.

name.description: The name of the person behind it, or null.

apiKey.description: The key that acted when `kind` is `api-key`, otherwise null.

from.description: The column a move left, with id, slug and label.

to.description: The column a move or a creation set, with id, slug and label.

cause.description: Why the app moved the card on its own, or null.

run.description: The whole record of a finished run, on a `run-finished` event.

pause.description: On a `paused` or `pause-released` event: kind, ruleId and releaseReason.

override.description: On a `review-overridden` or `override-ended` event: approver and headSha.

document.description: On a `document-verdict` or `verdict-failed` event: documentId, title, rule, verdict, withdrawn and refusal.

humanReview.description: On a `human-review-changed` event: value, cause and ruleId.

valueChange.description: On a `value-changed` event: key, value and previous.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

cardId.description: The id of the discovery card.

cardNumber.description: The number of the discovery card.

state.description: The state of the run. A new run is `requested`.

url.description: The Workshop page of the project in the app. Its discovery row shows the run, and opens the report once the worker has written it.

path.description: The path that was asked, as owner/name.

status.description: `in-project`: the project holds the repository through the App. `free`: the App reaches it and no project holds it. `other-project`: another project holds it. `not-shared`: the App does not reach it.

number.description: The card number, or null for a card that the experiment lists but the board and the runs no longer name. A card with no number cannot be excluded.

title.description: The card title, or null when the card is gone.

variant.description: The variant that did the work, or null when none is known.

pullRequestUrls.description: Every pull request link of the card, oldest first.

leftOut.description: Why the comparison leaves the card out. Empty for a card that counts.

exclusion.description: The manual exclusion of the card, or null.

excludedBy.description: The full name of the author, or null when the account is gone.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

reason.description: Why the card does not fit the question of the experiment. Surrounding blanks are cut off.

name.description: The name of the experiment, as the runs name it.

cards.description: How many cards the runs and the pins of the experiment name.

lastRunAt.description: The time of the last run of the experiment, or null when only pins name it.

archived.description: True when the owner archived the experiment and no run has brought it back.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

archived.description: True when the owner archived the experiment and no run has brought it back.

baseline.description: The variant that the rule names as the baseline, or null when the experiment names none.

confidenceLevel.description: The level of every range in the answer.

declaredMetrics.description: The metric keys the rule declares, in their order, or null when it declares none and the default metrics apply.

unknownMetrics.description: The declared metric keys that no metric has.

unknownGuards.description: The guard keys that no metric has. The headline leaves them out.

minFinishedCards.description: The finished cards a variant needs before its figure counts.

headline.description: The goal, the baseline, one comparison for each variant other than the baseline, the controls and the guards.

goal.description: What the experiment tries to improve. `problem` is `unknown-metric` for a goal key that no metric has, `no-direction` for a goal with no better way, else null. With a problem there is no comparison.

direction.description: The better way, `lower` or `higher`, or null when the rule names none.

baselineArm.description: The baseline, or null with no baseline.

comparisons.description: One entry for each variant other than the baseline, in name order. Empty when the experiment stores no baseline. `state` is `held` when a control on the variant or on the baseline does not pass, and `not-enough-cards` when an arm has fewer finished cards than `minFinishedCards`. `change` is null for those two states. `changeKind` is `relative` for a fraction of the baseline point, and `difference` for a ratio.

change.description: A value and its range at `confidenceLevel`, or null when it has no data.

heldBy.description: The metric keys of the controls that hold the comparison, or null.

change.description: A value and its range at `confidenceLevel`, or null when it has no data.

controls.description: The checks that the treatment of a variant applied. A control changes no figure and leaves no card out.

expect.description: A comparison and a number, such as `> 0`.

guards.description: The metrics that the experiment must not worsen. An empty list means no guards.

variants.description: The variants, by name, over the cards the figures keep.

models.description: Every model its experiment runs asked for, sorted.

weight.description: Null when the bridge sent none.

finishedCards.description: The kept cards that merged or stand in a terminal column.

runs.description: Every worker run of the kept cards.

costUsd.description: The cost of those runs in US dollars, or null when no kept card reported usage.

coveredCostUsd.description: The cost of the runs of the experiment of a covered kind, or null.

metrics.description: The metrics in display order. `byVariant` maps each variant name to its value and range, or to null. `clear` is true when every variant is clear against the baseline, false when one is not, and null with no baseline. `parts` has the same shape, one row for each value that a template count splits by reason, role or kind.

additionalProperties.description: A value and its range at `confidenceLevel`, or null when it has no data.

leftOutCards.description: The cards the figures leave out.

archived.description: True archives the experiment, and false brings it back. Archiving only hides it from the main list. A run that Loupe records after the archive brings the experiment back by itself.

name.description: The tag, as it is stored: lower case, with the surrounding spaces cut off.

documentCount.description: How many documents carry the tag. Archived documents count, so the number can exceed what the document list shows.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

name.description: The name, as its first document spelled it or a rename wrote it.

documentCount.description: How many documents the series holds. Archived documents count.

highestOrdinal.description: The highest position in use, which says what the next free number is. Null for a series that no document belongs to.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

name.description: The new name, stored as you spell it. It must not belong to another series, ignoring case.

number.description: The short label that counts from 1 inside this project.

origin.description: Who wrote the item: `agent`, `loupe`, or `api-key` for an item an API key created.

closeCause.description: Why Loupe, a rule or an agent closed the item. Null for a response of the owner.

dismissible.description: Whether the owner may dismiss the item.

blocking.description: Whether an agent waits on the item. Always false for an item from the API.

cardNumbers.description: The numbers of the linked cards, lowest first.

selectedOptions.description: The indexes of the options the owner picked, counting from 0.

note.description: The words of whoever closed the item: a written answer, a dismiss note or a withdraw reason.

review.description: The target and the verdict of a review item, otherwise null.

asks.description: Every ask that holds the item. An ask with no session is held by Loupe or made by the API.

cardId.description: The card of an automatic item, otherwise null.

waits.description: Each reason the card of an automatic item waited, oldest first. Empty for other items.

suggestedActions.description: The built-in actions the asking agent suggests.

actions.description: Each action the owner ran on the item, oldest first.

apiKey.description: The key that created the item when `origin` is `api-key`, otherwise null. The name is the one the key had then, and stays when the key is removed.

kind.description: A `question` takes options, freeText or both. A `todo` is marked done or declined. A `notice` only informs, and the owner dismisses it.

body.description: Markdown. Write a card as `card:<number>` and a pull request as `pr:owner/repo#<number>`.

options.description: The answers the owner picks from. A question only.

multiple.description: Whether the owner may pick several options. It needs at least two options.

freeText.description: Whether the owner may write an answer.

blocking.description: Always false. Nothing waits on an item from the API, so `true` is refused.

cardIds.description: Cards of this project. Any other id is refused.

documentIds.description: Documents of this project. Any other id is refused.

dedupeKey.title: The trimmed key, or null when it is absent or blank.
dedupeKey.description: A key of your choice. While an open item of the project holds the same key, the call returns that item with 200 and creates nothing. Once that item closes, the next call creates a new item. Blank counts as no key.

url.description: The review page of the document in the app, at the latest version.

references.description: The documents this one points at.

referencedBy.description: The documents that point at this one.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last page.
